Historical Open Auto Lite 0.4 projection dependency summary.

This retained record describes the projection module before the LibreAuto merge,
not the complete unified application's dependency graph. The host adds LibVLC
3.7.7 and Shizuku API/provider 13.1.5. See app/build.gradle.kts,
projection/build.gradle.kts and UPSTREAM.md for current declarations/notices.

Direct declarations:
  org.maplibre.gl:android-sdk:13.7.1
  org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-coroutines-android:1.9.0
  androidx.core:core-ktx:1.13.1

The accepted build's MapLibre dependency raises coroutines Android/core to 1.10.2.
The Kotlin plugin/standard library version is 2.2.20. Exact notices for these
components and MapLibre's native/transitive components are retained in
projection/src/main/assets/licenses/ and described in third_party/README.md.

This summary distinguishes declarations from resolved versions; it is not a
complete transitive dependency lockfile. Gradle's releaseRuntimeClasspath
dependency report is the authority for a new build's complete resolved graph.

The retained Lite core has no Vosk, JNA or Shizuku dependency and no bridge source set;
the unified LibreAuto host does include its separate optional Shizuku integration.
The separately built optional Open Auto Dictation add-on has its own Vosk/JNA
dependencies and notices; its model is not bundled in either APK or source.
